parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State what is meant by the capacitance of a parallel plate capacitor.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
A capacitor of capacitance $C$ is connected into the circuit shown in Fig. 7.1.

{{figure:figure_7_1.png}}

When the two-way switch is in position A, the capacitor is charged so that the potential difference across it is $V$. The switch moves to position B and the capacitor fully discharges through the sensitive ammeter.

The switch moves repeatedly between A and B so that the capacitor charges and then discharges with frequency $f$.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text:
Show that the average current $I$ in the ammeter is given by the expression

$$I = fCV.$$

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
For a potential difference $V$ of $150\text{ V}$ and a frequency $f$ of $60\text{ Hz}$, the average current in the ammeter is $4.8\ \mu\text{A}$.

Calculate the capacitance, in pF, of the capacitor.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
A second capacitor, having the same capacitance as the capacitor in **(b)**, is connected into the circuit of Fig. 7.1. The two capacitors are connected in series.

State and explain the new reading on the ammeter.
